name: agent-interactive-terminal
description: A real PTY terminal that the agent and the user share, with screen snapshots, named keys, a takeover lease, and password prompts that never reach the model.

interface.shortDescription: A real terminal the agent and you can share.
interface.longDescription: Open persistent shell sessions, read stable screen snapshots, wait on patterns, send named keys, and take over the same PTY in a browser panel. Passwords and other secrets can be typed by the person without entering the model context.
defaultPrompt: Open a terminal and run the project's test watcher.
Start a Python REPL and work through the data step by step.
